answer: When k bonded identities equivocate in a coordinated pattern, the protocol detects their shared evidence and applies pairwise slashing, yielding O(k²) penalties rather than treating each claim in isolation. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss through escrow forfeiture and asymmetric depreciation, making a tide of sybils costly to maintain; even an onyx stake cannot whisper its way past correlated proofs.
